says: Incident.drop reads an unreadable issue list as no open issues, so with a fix named it prints 'no fix is named' and drops nothing.
proof: Run on the head with a log holding a fix line for fabrikalfa/x and AlertsTest failing: `Incident.drop` printed 'sev: no fix is named'; with the list readable it printed 'sev: fabrikalfa/x is not the fix now landing any more'.
cost: During a rate limit the lead is told no fix is named while one still is, and a later fix is refused as a second fix.
